name: Toilet de Itazura
source:
Sensual times with a little girl you meet innocently playing at the park...

"B, but... go to the bathroom... together?..." 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE102171.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
與你在公園裡偶然遇見、正在獨自玩耍的小女孩共度情色時光……

「可、可是……要一起去廁所嗎……？」
